_about: Dimethyl sulfoxide (1) + Ethyl acetate (2): isobaric bubble temperatures at 101.3 kPa (no vapour compositions are fitted). Rows: liquid mole fraction of dimethyl sulfoxide, boiling temperature in K, as stored in the ThermoML Archive record (mole fractions of the other component converted with x_1 = 1 - x_2).

source.citation: Wang, Yinglong, Zhang, Hongru, Pan, Xiangshuai, Yang, Jingwei, Cui, Peizhe, Zhang, Fangkun, Gao, Jun, Isobaric vapor-liquid equilibrium of a ternary system of ethyl acetate + propyl acetate + dimethyl sulfoxide and binary systems of ethyl acetate + dimethyl sulfoxide and propyl acetate + dimethyl sulfoxide at 101.3 kPa, J. Chem. Thermodyn. 135 (2019) 116-123
source.access: The journal article may be subscription-only; the same data is public in the NIST TRC ThermoML Archive (NIST open license).
source.tables: ThermoML record, PureOrMixtureData 4, 5. The table number in the article was not checked.

notes: Read with validation/python/vle_batch.py. Fitted to the bubble temperatures alone (Barker's method): no set of this pair with vapour compositions passes the consistency point test, or none was measured. Pure-component boiling points of the set within 0.90 K of the vapour-pressure records. To be checked by a person against the record (AGENTS.md rule 4).
